gcode-sim Source on GitHub

G-code, simulated.

Paste a CNC milling program or pick an example. A C++ engine checks it for mistakes, works out the cycle time from the machine's acceleration and corner speeds, and plays the toolpath back in 3D. Everything runs in your browser: it's the same code as the command-line tool, compiled to WebAssembly.
